en.headline: HKEX opens photo exhibition marking 40 years at Exchange Square
en.dek: The four-week free display at the Rotunda traces Hong Kong’s modern stock exchange history through rare images, footage and artefacts, opening to the public from Monday afternoon.
body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited launched a photo-led exhibition on Monday celebrating 40 years of Hong Kong’s modern stock exchange at Exchange Square.

Titled “A Place to Connect: Our 40 Years at Exchange Square”, the four-week show occupies the Rotunda on the third floor of One and Two Exchange Square in Central. It features five themed zones with rare photographs, newspaper clippings, archival footage and market artefacts, covering the journey from the trading-floor era to today’s connected marketplace.

A launch ceremony was held earlier on Monday with Acting Financial Secretary Michael Wong among the guests, alongside legislators, market regulators, former HKEX chairmen and representatives from Hongkong Land, the exhibition’s strategic partner.

The exhibition is open daily from 10 am to 7 pm until 23 October, with Monday’s public opening starting at 3 pm. Admission is free. HKEX said it would also expand community engagement through an elevated Connect Hall and is planning a new museum for 2027.

zh.headline: 港交所展開交易廣場40周年圖片展
zh.dek: 為期四周的免費展覽於交易廣場圓形大廳展出珍罕照片、影像及文物，追溯香港現代證券交易所發展，周一下午起向公眾開放。
body: 香港交易及結算所有限公司周一推出圖片展覽，紀念香港現代證券交易所在交易廣場運作40周年。
展覽名為「連繫之所：交易廣場40載」，為期四周，於中環交易廣場一期及二期三樓圓形大廳舉行。展區分為五個主題，展出珍罕照片、剪報、歷史影像及市場文物，展示由交易大堂年代至今日全球互聯市場的演變。
周一早前舉行開幕禮，署理財政司司長黃偉綸、立法會議員、監管機構代表、前港交所主席及策略夥伴置地公司代表等出席。
展覽每日上午10時至晚上7時開放，直至10月23日，周一公眾開放時間由下午3時起，免費入場。港交所表示，將透過提升的連繫展廳加強社區參與，並計劃於2027年設立新博物館。
